title: Garage lights kill outdoor / Ring power
description: I want the outdoor feed (Ring camera / always-on outlet) to stay powered when the garage lights are switched off. Right now the wall socket that feeds outside appears tied into the light-switch circuit — power drops when the lights go off. Photos show mixed older wiring: metal boxes, conduit, yellow NM cable into a secondary box at the switch. Goal: leave lighting switched; move the yellow outdoor feed onto an always-hot source if that is safe and correct. Looking for advice organized by path: hire an electrician vs DIY-with-caution vs need more evidence.
coachLine: Safety warning: electrical work can injure or kill. Do not touch live conductors. Prefer a licensed electrician if you are unsure. This page collects advice for humans — it is not a wiring permit or verified splice plan.
note: Pilot public ticket. Photos are cropped and re-encoded without EXIF. Wide exterior shots omitted. All tickets are anonymized but may be used to train the SI (Super Intelligence, i.e. AI).
